note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. The Timascus dial, white subdials, minute track flange, tachymeter ring, BULOVA plate and prints are the photo map; indices, numerals, hands, bezel, case, crown, pushers and bracelet are modelled.

case.note: round body under the bezel; the cushion flanks and lug horns are one slab from the silhouette

hands.note: hour and minute: white lume in a polished frame; chrono: white needle; subdial: black needles

crown.note: fluted, sized from the photo (8 mm across, ends 25.6 mm from the pivot)

pushers.note: blue pusher blocks at 2 and 4: outer edge from the photo silhouette, 3.5 mm wide, starting under the case flank (top below the flank top, so only the part outside the flank shows), round ends

bracelet.note: House curl (SUR419P1): 7 mm radius from the lug tips, end_y = tip + 2.2 R. Pitch from the first top joints (5.5 / 5.8 mm); the later and the bottom joints are foreshortened by the curl and the camera angle

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers (model-viewer/three.js) render transmission from a low-resolution buffer and blur the dial

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL downscaled to 1K (keeps the GLB under 10 MB); lines run along the bracelet; bevels keep the plain polished material

notes: Modelled: cushion steel case with lug horns, blue anodised bezel ring and black groove, applied white bar indices in polished frames (long at 12, wide at 3 6 9), applied white numerals traced from the photo, white hour and minute batons in polished frames, white chrono needle with a lozenge, black subdial needles, fluted crown, blue paddle pushers at 2 and 4, three-column brushed bracelet.
From the photo map: the blue Timascus dial, the white subdials and their scales, the minute track, the tachymeter ring, the BULOVA plate and 262 kHz.
The photo was turned 1.9 degrees; it was straightened first. Hands and applied parts were removed from the dial map by copying the same row left or right, since the waves run across the dial.
Scale is the listed 43.5 mm case. Heights are estimated (no side photo). The camera sits slightly toward 6 in the photo, so the case outline is the average of the top and bottom halves.
